entries.title: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in DR Congo a global health emergency

entries.snippet: BBC Verify has examined dozens of videos of fibre-optic drone attacks carried out by the Lebanese armed group.

entries.snippet: Staff Sgt Mohamed Mahdhee died while diving in the search-and-rescue operation, the Maldives government tells the BBC.

entries.snippet: Wildlife experts had previous criticised the operation, saying it would only cause the animal more distress.

entries.snippet: The individual is one of four former passengers on the MV Hondius isolating on Vancouver Island, British Columbia.

entries.snippet: No group has yet claimed responsibility for the attacks, which have devastated Mussa town in Borno state.

entries.snippet: Charges could come as soon as next week in a case reportedly focused on Cuba's downing of two planes in 1996.

entries.snippet: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

entries.title: Foreign tourists are falling out of love with Goa - here's why
entries.snippet: Foreign visitors to Goa have nearly halved from their pre-Covid peak even as domestic tourism is booming.

entries.snippet: After four years of flops, the BBC has to think hard about how it approaches Eurovision in 2027.

entries.title: The girl group who've sold out venues and toured the world - without releasing a record

entries.title: Executions nearly doubled in the U.S. last year, and soared abroad
entries.snippet: The number of people killed in state-sanctioned executions worldwide rose to a 44-year high in 2025, according to a new report from Amnesty International.

entries.title: One clinic tracks the heavy toll Trump's immigration crackdown takes on mental health
entries.snippet: Zocalo Health, a clinic in Los Angeles, screens all its patients for depression, anxiety and suicidal thoughts. It documented a marked increase in those conditions since ICE enforcement actions began.

entries.title: The foreign fighters who helped topple Assad — and why China worries about them
entries.snippet: Thousands of Uyghurs became key fighters against Syria's Assad regime. For the first time, they agreed to be interviewed. NPR spent weeks with some of them to understand why they fled China for Syria.

entries.title: How a CEO and Trump donor is weaponizing tariffs against his rivals
entries.snippet: Cambria CEO Marty Davis has successfully asked the U.S. government to put tariffs on quartz. His business competitors are crying foul.

entries.title: New burn bans and Trump's battle with immigration and DEI are impacting forest fires
entries.snippet: Firefighters say setting fires on purpose is one of the best ways to protect against massive wildfires later. But the Trump administration is banning or stalling preventative burning across the U.S.

entries.title: New York Magazine reviewing work of writer facing plagiarism allegations
entries.snippet: The high-profile writer, who has written a forthcoming book about New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani, is being investigated by the magazine after being called out for copying the work of other writers.

entries.title: Louisiana senator who voted to convict Trump loses Republican primary
entries.snippet: Sen. Bill Cassidy is one of few remaining Republican senators who voted to convict President Trump after the Jan. 6 attack on the Capitol. Trump endorsed his opponent, Rep. Julia Letlow.

entries.title: Napoleon Solo holds off Iron Honor to win the Preakness
entries.snippet: It's the colt's first victory of the year. Kentucky Derby winner Golden Tempo's exit from the race left the field of 14 horses wide open to contest the middle jewel of the Triple Crown.

entries.title: Bulgarian banger 'Bangaranga' bags country its 1st Eurovision win
entries.snippet: Bulgaria was not among the favorites to win. But performer Dara's catchy, banging anthem bested 24 other nations at the 70th edition of the international singing extravaganza.

entries.title: World Health Organization declares Ebola outbreak in Congo a global health emergency
entries.snippet: Health officials are working to contain a new Ebola outbreak in the DRC of a virus strain with no known vaccine.

entries.title: Bulgaria wins the 70th Eurovision Song Contest with 'Bangaranga'
entries.snippet: Dara beat 24 other competitors during Saturday's grand final in Vienna. The song's infectious beats and tightly choreographed dance routine was a hit with both viewers.

entries.title: Rwandan genocide suspect dies in custody in The Hague
entries.snippet: Félicien Kabuga, 91, was accused of encouraging and bankrolling the mass killing of Rwanda's Tutsi minority. His trial began in 2022, nearly three decades after the 100-day massacre that left 800,000 dead.

entries.title: Thousands rally in birthplace of Civil Rights Movement to defend Black political representation
entries.snippet: A crowd of thousands gathered in front of the city's historic Alabama Capitol, the place where the Confederacy was formed in 1861 and where the Rev. Martin Luther King, Jr. spoke in 1965 at the end of the Selma-to-Montgomery Voting Rights March.

entries.snippet: Analysts at investment bank Morgan Stanley estimate the underserved market could be worth up to $1 trillion in annual sales.

entries.snippet: The aircraft carrier returned home to Virginia on Saturday after an 11-month deployment, the longest since the Vietnam War.

entries.snippet: The announcement comes less than 24 hours after U.S. President Donald Trump finished his own state visit to China, where he also met Xi to discuss trade and the U.S. and Israel's war in Iran.

entries.snippet: The Long Island Rail Road in New York ceased operations early Saturday morning after five unions representing about half its workforce walked off the job.

entries.snippet: Health workers raced Saturday to intensify screening and contact tracing to contain the disease.

entries.title: U.S. and Nigerian mission kills Islamic State group leader, Trump says
entries.snippet: Trump made the announcement of the joint operation to take out Abu-Bilal al-Mainuki in a late-night social media post Friday that offered few details.

entries.title: Trump disparages incumbent Sen. Cassidy and tries to propel his challenger in Louisiana GOP primary
entries.snippet: Trump endorsed U.S. Rep. Julia Letlow over Cassidy, in an unusual attempt to dislodge an incumbent senator. Cassidy voted to convict Trump in his second impeachment trial.

entries.title: Israel says it killed a top Hamas leader
entries.snippet: Izz al-Din al-Haddad, a leader of Hamas' military wing. He was one of the last surviving architects of the October 7, 2023, attacks that triggered the war in Gaza.

entries.title: Supreme Court rejects bid to restore Virginia congressional map favoring Democrats
entries.snippet: In recent days, the justices have sided with Republicans in Alabama and Louisiana who hope to redo their congressional maps to produce more GOP-leaning seats following the court's voting rights decision.

entries.title: Trump and Xi pledge 'strategic stability' but key questions remain unanswered
entries.snippet: President Trump is returning to Washington after a summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping. The two sides announced they would launch a board of trade and investment, but beyond that, there are few specifics. Nick Schifrin reports from Beijing on the pageantry and the policy.

entries.title: Trump's 'elaborate' praise of Xi at China summit made U.S. look weak, ex-ambassador says
entries.snippet: For perspective on the summit between President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, Amna Nawaz spoke with Nicholas Burns. He served as U.S. ambassador to China during the Biden administration and is now at Harvard University.

entries.title: Live Results: Louisiana midterm state and congressional primaries
entries.snippet: Sen. Bill Cassidy was decisively defeated in Saturday's Republican primary in Louisiana, U.S. Rep. Julia Letlow and state Treasurer John Fleming have advanced to a runoff in Louisiana's Republican Senate primary.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russia in massive overnight attack
entries.snippet: Ukraine has launched almost 600 drones at Russia in one of its largest overnight attacks amid Moscow's invasion. The region around the Russian capital was one of those targeted.

entries.title: Two Nepali climbers break own Everest records
entries.snippet: Two veteran Nepali climbers, a man and a woman, have each set new records for ascents of the world's highest mountain. The 492 Everest climbing permits issued by Nepal for the 2026 spring season represent another high.

entries.title: German transport minister promotes green hydrogen in Japan
entries.snippet: During a recent visit to Japan, Germany's transport minister Patrick Schnieder toured hydrogen projects aimed at bringing the fuel into the mainstream.

entries.title: North Korean women's football team makes rare visit to South
entries.snippet: A North Korean women's football club has become the country's first group of athletes in eight years to visit the South.

entries.title: Dead humpback whale off Denmark is 'Timmy'
entries.snippet: Divers have confirmed that a dead humpback whale spotted off Denmark is the same creature that spent weeks beached off Germany's Baltic coast. It comes two weeks after a contentious rescue operation.

entries.title: Germany news: UNICEF says child well-being ranking 'alarming'
entries.snippet: A new study ranks Germany near the bottom in child well-being and education. Meanwhile, authorities say a dead humpback spotted off Denmark is the same creature that spent weeks beached off Germany's coast. DW has more.

entries.title: India news: CNG gas price hiked in Delhi NCR amid Iran war fallout
entries.snippet: The price of CNG has increased in Delhi and the surrounding region for the second time in two days, as India grapples with the economic impact of the Iran war. Meanwhile, Modi is set to arrive in Sweden. DW has more.

entries.title: WHO declares international emergency over Ebola outbreak
entries.snippet: The World Health Organization said the Ebola outbreak could be much larger than what is currently being detected and reported. It warned of health risks to other countries.

entries.title: Venezuela deports Maduro ally Alex Saab to US
entries.snippet: Alex Saab fell out of favor with the new administration that took power since Maduro’s ouster and capture by US forces in January.

entries.title: Rwandan genocide suspect Felicien Kabuga dies in custody
entries.snippet: Rwanda's Felicien Kabuga was once one of the world's most-wanted fugitives. He was accused of encouraging and bankrolling the 1994 genocide.

entries.title: Bulgaria's Dara wins Eurovision Song Contest 2026 in Vienna
entries.snippet: Bulgaria has won the 70th Eurovision Song Contest. The kitsch pop music extravaganza, the world's biggest live music contest, has again been overshadowed by protests and a boycott over Israel's participation.

entries.title: Eight injured after car ploughs into crowd in Italy's Modena
entries.snippet: Investigators are still determining if the driver acted deliberately. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called the incident in Modena "extremely serious."

entries.title: Germany gets ahead in the new space race
entries.snippet: German companies of all sizes and all over the country are developing satellites and space applications. They want to be part of the lucrative industry, which is increasingly crucial for civilian and military purposes.

entries.title: Could Romania and Moldova reunite?
entries.snippet: Moldovan leader Maia Sandu and her Romanian counterpart Nicusor Dan want to reunite their countries. Is that a realistic scenario?

entries.title: Thailand: Bangkok rail crossing collision kills at least 8
entries.snippet: A collision between a freight train and a bus occurred in downtown Bangkok. Fatal road accidents are not uncommon in Thailand.

entries.title: UK far-right group stages anti-immigration protest in London
entries.snippet: Far-right activist Tommy Robinson gathered thousands in London, urging them to "get involved" or "lose their country forever."

entries.title: Middle East: Drone strike sparks fire at UAE nuclear plant
entries.snippet: No party has claimed responsibility for the strike on the Barakah nuclear power plant, but Iran has repeatedly launched attacks on the UAE since the start of the war. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Study: Immigrants disadvantaged in German housing market
entries.snippet: The German housing market crisis is deepening social inequality. Newcomers in particular are struggling to find affordable housing — with consequences for integration, education, and the labor market.

entries.title: 'From collection to connection': How museums are redefining themselves
entries.snippet: Gone are the days when museums were just places to see art and artifacts. On International Museum Day, DW looks at how museums are becoming unique spaces of community engagement and participation.
